title: Cycloserine (and terizidone)
dek: A D-alanine analogue that nicks peptidoglycan assembly. CNS toxicity is the dose-limiting host story. Salvage Group C; catalogue still hungry for paired MIC data.
story: D-cycloserine mimics D-alanine and inhibits alanine racemase (Alr) and D-ala-D-ala ligase (Ddl), weakening PG cross-link precursors. Terizidone is a pro-drug dimer used in some programmes as a stand-in. Neither is Group A. They appear in longer individualised regimens when the 6- and 9-month orals do not apply.

Psychiatric and neurologic toxicity (psychosis, depression, seizures) is dose- and level-related. TDM exists in expert centres. Pyridoxine is often co-prescribed. Start low, rummage the psych history before you start, and do not combine casually with other pro-convulsants.
Resistance genetics (alr, ddl, ald) are incomplete in the catalogue; WHO has called for more paired data. Do not over-call a random alr SNP.
deep: True salvage, CNS TB sometimes (CSF penetration is a reason people still reach for it).
Renal clearance: adjust in renal failure or you buy CNS events.

visual.caption: Cycloserine sits at peptidoglycan precursor assembly. The host cost sits in the CNS. Salvage, not a 6-month letter.

example.title: New psychosis week 3 of Cs
example.setup: Longer individualised XDR regimen including cycloserine 750 mg daily. Family reports new paranoia. Levels not sent.

steps.title: Hold Cs
steps.body: This is the textbook AE. Do not add a third antipsychotic first.

steps.title: If you must restart, TDM and a lower dose
steps.body: Or rebuild without Cs if other drugs allow.

steps.title: Keep TB therapy complete
steps.body: Dropping Cs without replacement in a thin regimen is how you lose BDQ next. Count remaining active drugs.
